headline: India box office: Ramayana leads the latest daily chart at ₹53.5 Cr
lede: Ramayana leads the latest reported daily India nett at ₹53.5 Cr on Day 8, taking cumulative India nett to ₹618.1 Cr and worldwide gross to ₹1,033.6 Cr on the Indian Box Office consensus desk.
body:
Good morning. This is the Indian Box Office morning brief for 2026-11-13 (IST desk date), written from the verified consensus board rather than any single trade headline. India still has no official theatrical auditor; every rupee figure below is a desk estimate, labelled so India nett is never confused with worldwide gross.

## Daily chart leader

Ramayana sits at the top of the latest-day India nett ranking with ₹53.5 Cr on Day 8. Cumulative India nett is ₹618.1 Cr; worldwide gross on this desk is ₹1,033.6 Cr. The title is filed as Indian and currently carries a working status of playing with verdict Pending.

Scene is next on the daily chart at ₹6.1 Cr (Day 7, cumulative India nett ₹117.7 Cr), with Mookuthi Amman 2 third at ₹0.8 Cr. Gaps between the top three matter more than the order alone: a soft midweek day for a long-runner can look “small” in absolute crores while still being a healthy hold for its week of release.
